blocks.text: Mynt Inc. (Mynt), the parent company of the group behind GCash, will hold its initial public offering (IPO) from October 6 to 12, 2026, at an offer price of ₱6.60 per share. The IPO shares will be available directly in the GCash app through GStocks PH, powered by AB Capital Securities Inc. The minimum order is 100 shares, or ₱660 at the offer price. There is no maximum order limit, subject to share availability. As an exclusive benefit for GStocks PH users, orders placed on October 6 and 7 will have their first 100 shares allocated in real time, while shares […]...
